mechanism: Fenofibrate may increase sacubitril levels through CYP3A4 inhibition and competition for renal clearance, with additive effects on lipid metabolism and potential for increased sacubitril-related hypotension.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely and renal function; consider dose adjustment of sacubitril if hypotension or renal deterioration occurs; ensure therapeutic benefit outweighs risks in heart failure patients.
